description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Dll_ZoneInfo, which extends OA_Info and contains properties and methods related to ad zone information in Revive Adserver, including zone attributes, default value setting, and field type definitions.

classes.name: OA_Dll_ZoneInfo
classes.description: Class representing ad zone information with properties like zoneId, publisherId, zoneName, type, dimensions, capping, comments, code snippets, chained zone, and methods for setting defaults and retrieving field types.

methods.name: setDefaultForAdd
methods.description: Sets default values for type, width, height, and chainedZoneId if they are null.

methods.name: getFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping each property to its data type.
